principle: A visually plausible strike is the goal. Tip contact and shaft contact are both valid when they preserve natural hand/wrist/stick geometry and fixed-drum semantics.

shaftContact.pass: Natural shaft/belly contact when chosen; no implausible penetration.

visualStrikePlausibility.pass: Strike direction, wrist angle, grip and instrument relation read as an intentional hit.

promotionRule: Contact success alone is insufficient. lineworkIntegrity + fixedDrumComposite + transitionContinuity must also pass.
